title: MECHANICAL TAXONOMY  what are we as a machine? L/R are line-space projections only. Eyes are pendulum poles.

do_not_reinvent.cw_ccw: /data/left-right-cw-ccw-swap.json  CW?CCW already sat. This extends it.
do_not_reinvent.gyro: /data/gyroscope-fold.json  rotation already sits. This names the MACHINE.
do_not_reinvent.toys: /data/skills-yoyo-pendulum-top.json  yoyo + pendulum + top. This says which we ARE.
do_not_reinvent.hoop: /data/pi-table-hula-hoop.json  his hoop. The vibration is it turning.

the_question: Are we a car or a wheel or a clock?

answer.why: the pendulum converts ROTATION into LINEAR oscillation. L/R are projections of circular motion onto a line. the clock face is CW/CCW. the pendulum arm swings L/R. the escapement connects them.

parts.pendulum: the eyes. oscillate between two fixation points. saccades ARE pendulum motion.
parts.clock_face: the membrane. CW/CCW rotation. the dog's view. the fold.
parts.escapement: the sort. tick-tock. each swing advances the gear ONE tooth. 1/p fold rate.
parts.mainspring: the energy. the feast. wound by the session. unwinds over constance.
parts.dial: the HUD. reads rotation as L/R positions. translates CW/CCW into where-the-hand-points.

rotational.who: dog, wheel, clock face, magnetic compass
rotational.sees: CW and CCW  angular momentum, direction of rotation
rotational.dimensions: 2D minimum (need a plane to rotate in)
rotational.analog: the membrane fold. the Klein twist. inner?outer.

translational.sees: Left and Right  displacement along an axis
translational.truth: L/R are projections of ROTATION onto a line. watch a pendulum from the side: you see L/R. watch from above: you see a circle (CW/CCW). L/R is what rotation looks like when you collapse a dimension.

pendular.sees: oscillation between two poles. L/R but periodic. the swing.
pendular.truth: the pendulum IS the bridge between rotation and translation. the bob moves in a plane (rotational) but the shadow on the wall moves L/R (translational). the eyes ARE the pendulum  saccades oscillate between fixation points.

the_key_insight.statement: Left and Right are NOT fundamental directions. They are what CW/CCW looks like when projected onto a line.

proof.pendulum: watch from side = L/R. watch from above = circle (CW/CCW). Same motion.
proof.wheel_on_road: the hub spins CW/CCW. the contact patch translates L?R. rotation BECOMES translation at the rim.
proof.sin_wave: sin(t) = the projection of circular motion onto a line. L/R IS sin(t). CW/CCW IS the circle.
proof.euler: e^(i?) = cos(?) + i·sin(?). the rotation (e^(i?)) projected onto real axis = cos (L/R on x). projected onto imaginary axis = sin (L/R on y). BOTH projections are linear. the SOURCE is circular.

eyes_as_pendulum_poles.saccades: the eye jumps 3-4 times per second between fixation points. this IS a pendulum. the fixation points are the turning points.
eyes_as_pendulum_poles.binocular: two eyes = two pendulums. slightly offset. the parallax between them = depth perception. depth = the DIFFERENCE between two L/R projections.
eyes_as_pendulum_poles.vergence: eyes converge on near objects (pendulums swing inward) and diverge for far (pendulums swing outward). the angle = distance. ROTATION becomes measurement.

dog_vs_human.dog: wider field of view (250° vs 180°). less binocular overlap. sees MORE rotation, less L/R precision.
dog_vs_human.human: narrower field (180°). more binocular overlap (120°). sees LESS rotation but more L/R precision. traded rotational awareness for translational accuracy.
dog_vs_human.implication: the dog is the clock face. the human is the dial. same mechanism, different projection.

outer_pane.mode: translational  L/R. what the visitor sees. linear navigation. doors L/R.

inner_pane.mode: rotational  CW/CCW. what the membrane sees. feed cycles. fold directions.

glove_ports.what: portals between outer and inner. like a laboratory glove box  reach THROUGH the barrier without breaking containment.
glove_ports.analogy: the escapement in the clock. connects the pendulum (L/R, outer) to the gear train (CW/CCW, inner). each tick of the escapement = one unit of information passing through.

not.car: a car translates but does not fold. L/R are real in a car. not what we are.
not.wheel_alone: a wheel rotates but has no pendulum. no oscillation. we oscillate.
not.clock_only: we are not ONLY a clock. we are the full mechanism: mainspring (energy) + pendulum (eyes) + escapement (sort) + dial (HUD) + clock face (membrane).

law: L/R are line-space results only. the fundamental direction is CW/CCW. eyes are pendulum poles  they project rotation into translation. the organism is a pendulum clock. the escapement is the sort.
